positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Envestnet develops asset management trading software with over $1T in assets under management
- Designed and developed backend (.NET) and database (SQL Server) to enable subdivision of accounts, ensuring seamless integration of new data concept into company data, and netting $10M revenue since launch
- Implemented user-based preferences for account rebalance view, including React components, API layer, and database changes, migrating from a browser-based cookie and enabling consistent user experience across user’s devices
- Performed extensive code reviews and coached teammates on best practices, including by leading live review sessions
- Migrated account management monolith into containerized REST API microservices, enabling  feature development to scale, while maintaining stability of highly critical trading workflow
- Directed, trained, and mentored early-career engineers, including selection and scoping of projects, resulting in improved performance and successful intern project
- Improved the clarity of Portfolio Rebalancing reporting by surfacing important trade information to customers, such as Unrealized and Realized Gains and Losses
- Standardized product permission checks across account management system by implementing a single permission module, streamlining enterprise license extensions and eliminating major security issues
- Updated Security Restriction module to persist change history, improving the security audit trail and reducing customer support requests

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Migrated 15 web application backend endpoints from .NET stack to Node.js
- Debugged production issues and delivered holistic fixes
- Designed solutions to user experience challenges and worked closely with product owners to integrate them into the roadmap and implement them
- Fostered a culture of direct and comprehensive code review, which encouraged collaboration and knowledge-sharing with offshore teammates

positions.title: Software Developer Student
positions.description:
- 2000+ hour educational program for women with an acceptance rate under 10%
- Worked independently and in teams of 2-4 to build web applications with Ruby on Rails, JQuery, Backbone, and React
- Areas of study included object-oriented design, relational databases, RESTful API creation and consumption, TDD, data structures and Agile practices
- Capstone: built a Korean language learning web application with React

positions.title: Clinical Research Coordinator (Lead)
positions.description:
- Increased team efficiency by leading research team in conjunction with clinical teams
- Launched clinical trial by developing in-house clinical trial procedures  
- Executed clinical research trials including patient consents, research procedures, and data abstraction  
- Ensured a productive and efficient team by selecting excellent applicants to join the team
- Helped increase the accuracy of databases by spot checking other’s work
- Increased quality of source documentation by managing the completeness and clarity of submitted materials

company.name: University of Washington - School of Medicine
